title: Toddler in Striped Swimsuit on Wicker Chair, 1950s B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century candid outdoor snapshot featuring a squinting toddler seated cross-legged in a woven wicker lounge chair on a sunny lawn. The child wears a classic striped knit tank swimwear or romper and holds a pen or pencil in hand while sitting under direct sunlight. The reverse side features a simple stamped code number '304C'.
